title: May Coup
summary: Wikidata item Q2403418, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "military assassinations of royal couple and government officials in Serbia". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: The Wikidata import wrote this lane from the event's own point. The event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.

retraction.reason: Retracted in M42 batch 8 under brief §1: the record earns no honest edge. The English article, at revision 1375001338, says the coup extinguished the Obrenović dynasty, passed the throne to the Karađorđević, and turned Serbia away from Austria-Hungary towards Russia and France. None of that reaches a record this atlas holds, and the article's Legacy section is a television series and a novel. The record waits on a record of Serbia between 1903 and 1912, or on a page that argues a line from the coup to the Balkan wars or to Sarajevo.
